en: A hand-tinted vintage postcard showing a quiet, cobblestone street lined with a mix of wooden and masonry buildings. The scene appears serene with a single person walking along the left side, near a fence and leafy trees. The buildings on the right display several signs, and the sky is rendered in soft blue and pink hues. The overall style and typography suggest an early 20th-century period.
